_about: Corrections to the scraper's images_manifest.json, keyed by the first 12 hex characters of each image file's SHA-1 (stable across re-scrapes even when file names change). An entry can set label (elevation, interior, gallery, floor-plan, master-plan, amenity, location-map, or skip), alt, project (our slug, for images shared across pages), and cover (first image of the project). Images without an entry use the manifest's label and suggested_alt. Checked by eye against every picture on 2026-10-06.
